# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is an aged, unwed woman with a stern countenance. She takes particular notice of people's ears and admires handsome men.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c23 P5](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0005), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009)_

## Personality

Tabitha is good-natured, loyal, and practical, preferring to work and brighten people's spirits rather than weep with them. She speaks her mind openly, does not hold grudges against men despite remaining unmarried, and takes immense pride in her culinary skills. Unbothered by political squabbles, she focuses pragmatically on everyday matters like baking and gardening.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P41](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0041), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 c35 P17](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0017), [v4 c40 P49](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0049)_

- Good-natured and loyal  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>
- Practical and industrious  <sub>[v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010), [v4 c40 P49](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0049)</sub>
- Particular about ears  <sub>[v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017)</sub>
- Indifferent to politics  <sub>[v4 c35 P17](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0017)</sub>

## Abilities

- Cooking and baking  <sub>[v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010), [v4 c23 P5](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0005), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007)</sub>
- Infant care  <sub>[v4 c35 P18](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0018), [v4 c35 P21](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- Faithfully serve and protect Nell Carrow and her household  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010), [v4 c36 P23](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0023)</sub>

## History

Tabitha Pratt was hired as a general servant for a few weeks at the small house where Nell and Dr. Hugh Carrow resided. Initially suspicious of Thirza Abernethy, Tabitha made peace with her when Thirza did not interfere in the kitchen during Nell's childbirth. She developed a deep, protective devotion to Nell, caring for her through the loss of her newborn infant and staying on through the summer at Hugh's request. When her sister Matilda fractured her leg, Tabitha briefly left to care for her before returning to her duties. She welcomed the household's eventual move to the larger Varley house in the Glen due to its superior cellars, pantries, and running water.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010), [v4 c22 P0](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0000), [v4 c36 P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 c38 P35](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0035), [v4 c40 P42](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0042), [v4 c40 P47](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0047), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058)_

## Background by volume

- Hails from the Glen  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- Has a sister named Matilda and a deceased aunt  <sub>[v4 c18 P53](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0053), [v4 c22 P8](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0008), [v4 c36 P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019)</sub>
- Cared for three sets of twins during her youth  <sub>[v4 c35 P20](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0020)</sub>
- Was never courted or proposed to by any man  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> Extremely ill—extremely ill, Winifred. I fear that she will shortly be in heaven, poor creature!  <sub>[v4 c18 P55](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0055)</sub>

> Time for breakfast now. It is my belief that some food and drink will be welcomed by us all. Instruct young Mrs. Doctor to be entirely free of concern—Tabitha is taking charge. Instruct her to occupy her thoughts solely with her infant.  <sub>[v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)</sub>

> An old maid I may be, yet you do not catch ME speaking ill of men. They suit me fine. Had the opportunity arisen, I would gladly have wed one. Mrs. Doctor, dear, isn't it peculiar that not a single man ever proposed marriage to me? Although I lack exceptional beauty, my appearance matches that of the majority of wives around us. Yet no man ever courted me. Why do you imagine that was?  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>

> And he possesses the most delightful little ears, Mrs. Doctor, dear. Looking at his ears was my very first action. Hair deceives and noses and eyes undergo changes, rendering it impossible to predict their outcome, but ears remain ears throughout, providing certainty at all times. Simply observe their form—and they rest directly against his precious head. His ears will never cause you embarrassment, Mrs. Doctor, dear.  <sub>[v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017)</sub>

> Well, weeping was never something I was skilled at, Mrs. Doctor, dear. Rather than weep alongside folk, I prefer to get to work and brighten their spirits. Now, avoid crying and ruining those pretty eyes of yours. Having served your purpose, this house is fine enough, yet you are long overdue for a superior one.  <sub>[v4 c40 P49](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0049)</sub>
